purpose: Validate that every active property fixture revalidation queue item has complete dependency, impact, historical and closure information before revalidation proceeds.

checks.name: Queue identity
checks.requirement: Queue item must reference an existing impact event and fixture.

checks.name: Dependency completeness
checks.requirement: All required dependent tests, runs, pathways and propositions must be represented.

checks.name: Historical preservation
checks.requirement: Referenced historical validation runs remain immutable.

checks.name: Action completeness
checks.requirement: Required revalidation actions must be explicit.

checks.name: Closure gate
checks.requirement: Closure conditions must include new validation evidence and impact-event linkage.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Queue completion must not automatically publish or upgrade a legal answer.

guardrails: This validates queue integrity, not Irish property law.
Queue validation cannot create live property evidence.
A synthetic fixture remains synthetic after queue validation.
Historical validation results cannot be rewritten.
Legal-source and publication verification remain separate gates.
